tonight.headline: Panda Attack, and a hole at D/ST
body: Bad news first. Your D/ST is Green Bay on bye, Garrett Wilson's quarterback is nursing an ankle, and Waddle has not practised since his concussion. Nothing has kicked off; ESPN projects 128.0 to 103.9 and gives you 63%.

Panda Attack's 103.9 counts two byes they can still fix — DeMario Douglas (New England) and Harold Fannin Jr. (Cleveland) — so the real gap is smaller. Your one move is the Steelers claim before 02:00 Wednesday.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Dallas–Tennessee carries a 53.5 total (FF Hound): Panda Attack start Prescott, Javonte Williams and Pickens from that game. If it shoots out and they fill their two bye seats, 24 projected points disappear fast.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Steelers claim that fails all three ways leaves 0.0 at D/ST; Geno Smith sitting would lower Wilson's ceiling.

doFirst.title: Claim the Steelers D/ST, drop the Packers D/ST
doFirst.subtitle: Then Chiefs, then Bears — each dropping the Packers. Green Bay are on bye and every free agent is on waivers.

case.label: The hole
case.body: Green Bay are on bye, so the Packers D/ST start at 0.0 and you have no second defence. Monday's plan — add the Bears as a free agent — died at the rollover: every unrostered player in Chem is now on waivers until Wed 18 Nov 02:00 CDMX (league file).

case.label: The pick
case.body: Steelers D/ST, 9.3 projected, the best on the wire. Philadelphia start Tanner McKee with Jalen Hurts out for the season with blood clots (Yahoo 19 Oct; Yahoo 16 Nov), and DeVonta Smith is on the Week 11 injury list with a hamstring (Yahoo 16 Nov).

case.label: The chain
case.body: Chem priority resets weekly, so stack three claims, each dropping the Packers: Steelers, then Chiefs D/ST (9.0) at home to Carson Beck, whose debut brought 5 sacks and 2 interceptions (FF Hound 16 Nov), then Bears D/ST (7.5) against Tyler Shough as 10-point home favourites (FF Hound). Only one can land.

case.label: Against it
case.body: AVIATO are 5th in waiver order and the Steelers are 81% owned league-wide; a rival may claim first. Steelers–Chiefs is 0.3 apart — a coin flip, which is why the chain exists.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The D/ST you end up with scores under 5, or the Chiefs D/ST outscore the Steelers D/ST in Week 11 (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The free-agent D/ST plan is gone
whatWentWrong.lead: Monday's brief planned to add the Bears as a free agent once Week 11 opened. At the rollover every free agent went to waivers, so it is a claim now.

case.label: What happened
case.body: All 139 unrostered players in Chem show WAIVERS, clearing Wed 08:00Z (league file, 12:50Z). The Packers scored 4 last week against the Giants' 5 (archive) and are on bye now.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The claim card above. A claim costs nothing lasting in Chem, but ordering still matters — rank by projection, not by when the idea came.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: If all three claims fail, the next free-agent window opens at 02:00 Wednesday: add the highest-projected D/ST left before Sunday 12:00.
